local.h: Clancy judge denies hearing on holdout juror
local.b: A judge rejected the defense's request for an evidentiary hearing on the lone juror in Lindsay Clancy's trial, which ended in a mistrial.

local.h: CPS approves $300K for family of bullied girl
local.b: The school board approved a settlement for the mother of a Black student who endured more than two years of racist bullying at a Northwest Side school.
local.title: CPS approves $300,000 for family of girl who endured years of racist bullying

local.h: CPS lunchroom workers win raises, avert strike
local.b: The board approved a new contract for about 1,500 lunchroom workers that raises wage floors after more than a year of talks.
local.title: CPS board approves new lunchroom workers contract that raises wages

local.h: Chicago Shakespeare chief Kimberly Motes to leave
local.b: Motes will step down in November after three years as executive director to lead Hennepin Arts in Minneapolis.
local.title: Chicago Shakespeare Theater chief Kimberly Motes to step down

local.h: ComEd data center hookups could hit households
local.b: ComEd expects to spend over $3 billion connecting data centers but has collected only about a quarter from developers, consumer groups warn.

local.h: Illinois doula law is failing families
local.b: An Illinois law meant to help new parents pay for doula care is falling short, families say.

goodnews.b: The 12th annual Halloween parade brings a fire-breathing dragon, giant puppets, drumlines and dance troupes to Columbus Drive on Saturday night.

local.h: MTA pulls bus fare enforcement teams
local.b: The MTA is temporarily shutting down its EAGLE bus fare teams after a Brooklyn school dean was roughed up by agents, Chair Janno Lieber said.
local.title: MTA suspending bus fare enforcement teams after altercations emerge

local.h: Ex-Adams aide accused of $120K in kickbacks
local.b: Anthony Herbert faces new federal charges that he took kickbacks from a nonprofit meant to fund community programs.
local.title: Ex-Adams aide accused of pocketing kickbacks from community program funds

local.h: A and C lines get $1.9B signal upgrade
local.b: The MTA will start a six-year project next month to install modern train signals on the A and C lines in Brooklyn and Queens.
local.title: MTA to begin 6-year project to upgrade signal tech on A and C lines in Brooklyn and Queens

local.h: Council to probe collapsed Hunts Point market deal
local.b: The City Council will hold a hearing on why a $650 million deal to modernize the Hunts Point Produce Market fell apart.
local.title: NYC Council to grill Mamdani officials on collapsed Hunts Point Produce Market deal

local.h: Fatal motorcycle crash closes GWB lanes
local.b: All upper-level lanes into New York on the George Washington Bridge closed during the morning rush after a motorcyclist was struck by a tractor-trailer.
local.title: Fatal motorcycle crash on George Washington Bridge disrupts morning commute

local.h: Council set to give nonprofits first shot at buildings
local.b: The City Council is poised to approve the Community Opportunity to Purchase Act, letting nonprofits bid on dilapidated buildings before they hit the open market.
local.title: Mamdani-backed housing bill will give nonprofits head start on buying NYC apartments

local.h: Ballot asks NYC to ease outdoor dining, bike lanes
local.b: Five proposed charter amendments on the November ballot could expand outdoor dining and speed up new bike and bus lanes.
local.title: Ballot questions ask NYC voters whether to cut red tape on outdoor dining, bike lanes

local.h: NYPD seized mom's Christmas gifts, never returned them
local.b: Police arrested a single mother on Christmas Eve 2024 and took the presents she bought for her five children. She never got them back.
local.title: The NYPD arrested a mom and took her kids' Christmas gifts. She never got them back.

local.h: Ex-detective held on $1M bail in GWB shooting
local.b: The former NYPD detective accused of killing a driver in a road rage shooting on the George Washington Bridge was held on $1 million bail at his arraignment.
local.title: Former NYPD detective held on $1M bail after police say he shot driver on GWB

local.h: Teen arrested in fatal Midtown subway shooting
local.b: A 17-year-old was charged with murder in the fatal shooting of a Bronx man at a Midtown subway station on Saturday, police said.
local.title: NYPD arrests 17-year-old in fatal Midtown subway platform shooting

goodnews.h: Forest Hills Stadium keeps concerts in neighbor deal
goodnews.b: A settlement ends years of litigation between the Queens venue and neighbors over noise, letting concerts continue for the foreseeable future.
goodnews.title: Forest Hills Stadium can keep its concerts under deal with neighbors

local.h: Storm warnings as 140km/h winds hit Brittany
local.b: Météo France put Brittany on orange alert for winds up to 140km/h, with alerts extending to northern France and parts of the Paris region on Friday.
local.title: Storm warnings as 140km/h winds forecast for Brittany

local.h: France moves to ban or curb Saturday protests
local.b: Macron said curfews and bans on protests by "groups without legitimacy" will be imposed for Oct. 24, though officially organised events including a Paris demo are allowed.
local.title: French authorities seek to ban or curb October 24th protests

local.h: 2027 Tour de France routes revealed
local.b: The men's Tour will start in Edinburgh, and the women's race will finish atop a volcano in central France.

local.h: Four dead as storms lash south of France
local.b: Storms brought high winds, heavy rain and flooding to the south coast. Three people died in Bouches-du-Rhône, where officials reported major damage.

local.h: Protests banned in parts of Paris Thursday
local.b: Rallies are banned from 8am to 8pm near the Elysée, parliament, the Louvre, the Champs-Elysées, Bastille, République and Châtelet-Les Halles.

local.h: Two killed in French fighter jet crash
local.b: A Mirage 2000D crashed during a training flight near its air base outside Nancy, killing its 27-year-old pilot and 44-year-old navigator.

local.h: Chemical safety at WA pulp mills hard to learn
local.b: After a deadly implosion at a Longview mill, information about hazardous chemicals at Washington pulp mills remains hard to come by despite right-to-know laws.
local.title: What we know (and don’t) about chemical safety at Washington’s pulp mills following deadly implosion

local.h: Wilson expands World Cup homeless plan citywide
local.b: Mayor Katie Wilson said a program that moved Pioneer Square homeless residents into housing before the World Cup will expand across Seattle at no extra cost.

goodnews.b: A Seattle resident paid a drummer to follow a megaphone-wielding street preacher for over an hour, and the clips went viral on Reddit.
